amendments.timing: after P2 execution began but before any primary P2 outcome summary was inspected
amendments.change: preregister a separate four-seed P2 extension, preserving the immutable five-seed cohort and permitting combined nine-seed inference only after an identical-contract pooling audit
amendments.reason: five independent seeds have a minimum attainable two-sided exact p-value of 0.0625; nine seeds lower that floor to 0.00390625 and make a nine-family Holm-adjusted value below 0.05 attainable

amendments.timing: before primary P2 core completion and before causal-factorial execution
amendments.change: replace the structurally unattainable five-seed Holm p<0.05 family success condition with the already registered positive-mean and nonnegative seed-cluster lower-interval condition; retain exact and Holm p-values for reporting
amendments.reason: five independent seeds permit only 32 exact sign assignments and a minimum two-sided p-value of 0.0625; no P2 outcome summary was inspected

amendments.timing: before any P4 systems cell was generated
amendments.change: align the local optional systems preflight at exactly 500000 tokens with its executable P4 manifest while retaining the separate official FlashMemory contract at 512000 tokens
amendments.reason: the paper-grade umbrella manifest used 512000 while the local P4 runner, P5 gate, and report consistently preregistered 500000; separating the two evidence contracts prevents a silent context-length substitution

amendments.timing: before any primary or extension causal-factorial held-out shard or causal outcome existed; P2 core execution was in progress and only liveness, shard-count, and provenance metadata had been inspected
amendments.change: disable outcome-dependent controller early stopping and require complete five-seed primary plus four-seed extension execution on both S55 and S151
amendments.reason: the old first-scale shortcut contradicted the preregistered central requirement that calibrated+pins versus fixed+pins reproduce across five seeds and two scales; full completion increases computation and prevents outcome-selected scale or arm coverage

amendments.timing: before any P3 benchmark dataset acquisition beyond the explicitly permitted immutable prefetch, before any P3 model prediction or result cell, and while P2 core execution was still in progress
amendments.change: require the terminal nine-seed confirmatory causal audit, in addition to the frozen five-seed primary core and causal audits, before every P3 dataset-generation, baseline-selection, natural-language, or safety execution path
amendments.reason: the watcher already sequenced P3 after the confirmatory extension, but the common P3 gate accepted only the primary cohort; binding the confirmatory audit in the executable gate prevents manual early execution and outcome-dependent evidence ordering

amendments.timing: before any P3 dataset acquisition, baseline selection, model prediction, or result cell and while the primary P2 core matrix was still running
amendments.change: require the digest-bound five-seed strict core audit and nine-seed confirmatory core audit, including raw-matrix SHA-256 and frozen statistical contracts, before every P3 execution path
amendments.reason: the common gate checked only the raw primary core completion count; requiring both audited core summaries prevents P3 from starting from complete-but-unaudited or digest-drifted Tier-S evidence

statistics.primary_inference_unit: independent training-seed mean; example/conversation bootstrap is descriptive within seed
statistics.paired_seed_randomization: exact enumeration of all 2^5 sign assignments for the five independent training-seed mean differences
statistics.seed_p_value_role: resolution-limited descriptive evidence; success gates use effect direction, corrected seed-cluster intervals, memory matching, and all-seed consistency rather than an impossible p<0.05 threshold

safety_stress.primary_causal_contrast: same-budget protected-prefix minus strongest memory-matched fixed
safety_stress.physical_constraint: protected tokens replace unprotected selections and may not increase kept tokens or resident KV bytes
safety_stress.claim_boundary: synthetic safety-retention transfer only; not a comprehensive safety certification

claim_boundary: M5 is evidence only against the tested one-token cross-layer global M2 interface on the pilot Tier-S workloads.
privacy: raw private prompts and large checkpoints remain external; aggregate results are digest-bound
